examples.5.1 Art direction and visual identity: Moonshift's Outpost Kepler-9 looks like a toy repair yard left on the kitchen table: cream hulls, terracotta patches, chunky bolts, and a low warm sun that never quite sets. Technician Mara Voss and B.E.E.P. read as hand-sized toys against the habitat, and every broken part is visibly repairable.
examples.5.2 Colour, lighting, and camera languag: Ground is regolith #E6CFB2, structures are cream #F7E6C8, and repairs are terracotta #E2683A; teal #7EF2E0 means powered, amber #FFC857 means interactable, and coral #FF7A5C means blocked. The camera sits 35 degrees high at a 45-degree field of view, and the key sun stays 20 degrees above the horizon so shadows fall behind props and never across the repair grid.
examples.5.3 Characters and environments: B.E.E.P. is the companion: cargo carrier and dust-complainer; boxy torso on wide treads with a small sensor head; cream body, terracotta trim, teal eyes; sage carry rack and patched knee; walk, carry, push, wave, idle-check, and 12 emotes. The habitat kit uses eight 2 m pieces and a 4 m antenna tower as the landmark every 40 seconds.
examples.5.4 UI art and iconography: The repair icon uses a 24 px grid, 2 px stroke, and 1 px corner radius, drawn as a wrench over a cracked hex; hover adds a 1 px amber ring and scales to 1.04, while disabled drops to 40 percent grey. Body text is Lato 16/18 pt, headings are Montserrat 24/32 pt, and dark mode sets #F7E6C8 text on #2C3A4E panels; light mode inverts the pair.
examples.5.5 Animation and VFX: B.E.E.P. ships with 8 locomotion sets, 24 idle loops, 60 interaction clips, 18 environment loops, and 30 UI transitions; the repair action holds contact for 3 frames and opens its cancel window at 60 percent of recovery. The welder VFX is a 0.4 s amber cone capped at 200 particles, and repair-mode hit-stop never exceeds 40 ms.
examples.5.6 Asset production plan: The vertical slice ships 2 hero characters, 60 props, 80 modular pieces, 20 VFX meshes, and 70 UI icons; the long cargo crate is PRP_Crate_Long_2m at 1,800 tris, with LOD1 at 720 and LOD2 at 270 on a 1K shared atlas. It clears blockout Monday, model review Wednesday, texture Friday, and the final gate in Hadley Depot before sprint end.
examples.5.7 Level and content production: Hadley Depot runs 12 minutes on the critical path, places one interaction every 20 m, and uses a 4 m antenna tower as its landmark every 40 seconds. Blockout passed when 4 of 5 players reached the airlock without a guide; the art pass replaced every grey surface with approved kit, and polish closed at 60 fps with no blocker bugs.
examples.5.8 Content matrix and scope: The launch matrix funds 6 levels at 320 hours each, 6 characters, 480 props and kit pieces, 140 animation sets, 24 UI screens, and an audio package for 8,840 hours and $531k at $60 per hour. The vertical slice is one 12-minute Hadley level with 70 percent final art; the cut list drops the second biome and fourth crew variant if the slice misses its playtest gate.
